items.title: Detect control-plane reachability in status output
items.context: Add a lightweight control endpoint probe and explicit unreachable/timeout/wrong-probe classification for status output.

items.title: Propagate reachability into control readiness and autopilot gating
items.context: Ready flags and autopilot/autorun should depend on control endpoint reachability to avoid false positives.

items.title: Update smoke tests and assertions for control endpoint reachability
items.context: Smoke suite should cover default, reachable, and unreachable states with deterministic reachability signals.
